title: Registry retention policy: keep served/advisory/shadow + last K candidate retrains per model, prune older registry-store entries, then GC their ml/experiments-runs dirs (the trainer-disk growth fix)
roadmap_unmapped_reason: trainer infrastructure hygiene; no milestone owns registry storage
note:
Filed 2026-11-27 by ML-PRIMARY on Manager 26a's instruction, from TRAINER-DISK-14GB-1127.
- Measured (trainer-vm-diag, 11:23Z): ml/experiments-runs is 10.5 GB in 103 runs, 10,950 timestamped daily-retrain subdirs (~1.4 MB each, 2026-05..11). 10,676 are referenced by ml/registry-store + ml/served, because the registry keeps every historical retrain.
- DESIGN FIRST (Tier 2): what reads old entries? Promotion history, drift tooling, LTR tooling, ml_plan_status, the trainer mirror. Then a keep rule (served / advisory / shadow, every manifest-pinned or evidence-cited run, plus the last K candidates), a dry-run list, and a manager OK before any prune.
- Queue: after ALPACA-OCO-PLACE-FIRST. Owner: ML-PRIMARY.
- Gates this adds or changes: none. 2026-11-27 11:58Z: due moved to 12-04 (Manager 26a).
- Measured trainer disk growth ~0.31 GB/day (19G free on 11-11 to 14G on 11-27). After the 11-27 GC, 16.4G free, which crosses the 15 GB floor around 12-01/12-02.
- Interim: slice-2 GC (<=1.4 GB) applied 11-27.
- Order: after ALPACA-OCO. If free disk < 15.5 GB before this lands, it jumps ahead of everything but real-money issues (manager). 2026-11-27 12:06Z slice-2 GC APPLIED with manager OK (trainer-vm-diag run 45995563746):
- Deleted 273 unreferenced experiments-runs subdirs, each >= 14 d old.
- Deleted 6 home scratch dirs whose unit results have landed (rq20260929_401_round, rq20260930_402_round, rq20261008_900_round_2022/2023/2024, rq902_903).
- df: 16,397M -> 16,890M free (83%).
⚠️ TRIP-WIRE (Manager 26a, binding): when trainer free disk drops below 15.5 GB, THIS row goes ahead of ALPACA-OCO-PLACE-FIRST and everything else except real-money issues. At ~0.31 GB/day that is about 4-5 days from 11-27 (around 12-01/12-02). 2026-11-27 12:25Z DESIGN step 1, who reads old entries (ML-PRIMARY, code read at origin/main):
1. Registry run METADATA (registry-store/<model>.json runs[]: metrics, at, code_revision, model_state_path strings) is READ:
   - ml/promotion/gates.py stability (metrics of the last 10 runs);
   - ml/promotion/live_parity.py (newest runs[].at);
   - training_center (latest run).
   It is small JSON, so it is KEPT; pruning entries is unnecessary.
2. Run ARTIFACT dirs (ml/experiments-runs/<model>/<run_id>/: model_state.json, metrics.json, manifest.json) are what fill the disk (10.5 GB, 10,950 dirs). Readers:
   - ml/shadow/factory.py resolves the SERVED entry.model_state_path, which is the newest run, OR an older incumbent when a cost-gated retrain was refused;
   - m23_ev_gate.py takes the newest model_state for one manifest;
   - training_center._mirror run_dir reads per-run metrics/manifest from the live-VM trainer mirror for display;
   - ml.registry.reconcile rebuilds runs[] from disk, strictly additive, so a missing dir never removes metadata.
3. Proposed KEEP rule per model: (a) the dir of the entry's top-level model_state_path (the served/incumbent artifact, whatever its age); (b) the newest K=14 run dirs; (c) any dir named in ml/configs, research/, docs/ (doc_ref, as trainer_dataset_gc) or comms/; (d) anything younger than 14 d. PRUNE every other run ARTIFACT dir. Registry JSON is untouched.
4. Expected: ~103 models x ~15 dirs x ~1.4 MB, about 2.2 GB kept, so roughly 8 GB freed, and growth is bounded at K per model instead of ~0.31 GB/day.
5. Open checks before the dry-run: (i) does the trainer mirror's sync to the live VM delete pruned dirs (training_center then renders '—' for old runs' metrics, acceptable but stated); (ii) is any rollback path loading an OLD run's model_state (none found yet).
6. Build: scripts/ops/trainer_run_retention.py (report-only default, --apply), modelled on trainer_dataset_gc.py's keep-reason printing, with tests; dry-run list to the manager before any delete. 2026-11-27 12:32Z DESIGN step 2, the open checks resolved (code read at origin/main):
(i) The mirror: scripts/ops/publish_trainer_mirror.sh rsyncs experiments-runs (metrics/manifest/model_state.json) to the live VM WITHOUT --delete. A trainer-side prune therefore never removes the live-VM mirror's copies: training_center keeps rendering old runs, and the shadow factory keeps resolving served states.
  Side finding: the live-VM mirror copy of experiments-runs grows without bound for the same reason. It is a smaller footprint (3 json files per run, not the full dir), but unmeasured. File it with the build.
(ii) Rollback: no code loads an OLD run's model_state. ml/experiments/runner.py cost gate scores the INCUMBENT (entry.model_state_path, KEEP rule a); ml/shadow/backfill.py uses entry.model_state_path (rule a); m23_ev_gate globs the newest model_state per manifest (rule b covers it).
Design stands. Building scripts/ops/trainer_run_retention.py next (report-only default). 2026-11-27 12:46Z DRY RUN (trainer-vm-diag run 45999269432; tool merged on main via #29480 at 12:30Z):

- Free disk 16,887M before.
